archetypes.name: step5c-recovery
archetypes.rationale: Step 5c now treats a missing composed plan as a recoverable validator defect.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5c missing-composed-plan recovery path. Verify that design-publish.sh emits the documented validator KVs and exits 4 before redaction, validation bypass, plan writes, rename, or publish side effects. Check that the SKILL.md recovery prose keeps Override limited to ordinary composed-plan validator defects. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: skip-validate-precondition
archetypes.rationale: The new regression depends on --skip-validate not bypassing the file precondition.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the skip-validate ordering in design-publish.sh and its harness. Confirm that the new D_SKIP_MISSING case uses an isolated tmpdir with fresh stub logs and that stale happy-path artifacts cannot satisfy the assertions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
